request: Make every PART 1 - GENERAL / PART 2 - PRODUCTS / PART 3 - EXECUTION heading bold and keep it with the next paragraph
summary: Bold every PART heading and keep it on the same page as the paragraph that follows, as tracked formatting changes the reviewer can see in Word; a heading that is already bold, or already kept with the next paragraph, is left alone.
assumptions: the PART headings are the paragraphs whose whole text reads 'PART n - NAME' (any dash); nothing else changes
bold is written as Word writes it (w:b and w:bCs) on every run of those headings and on their paragraph marks; a run that is already bold is left alone
keep-with-next goes on each heading paragraph; one that already has it is left alone
targeted formatting is tracked (decision 14.1): Word shows 'Formatted: Bold, Keep with next' under All Markup
a symbol/Wingdings run in a heading would be bolded too (bold does not change a glyph)
